threat_event: Nation-state actor exploits a known vulnerability in an internet edge router or an SBC nearing end of support and keeps long-term access to the carrier network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Network elements outside vulnerability scanning; 2 edge routers missed the 30-day critical patch target; 2 SBCs reach end of support 2026-12-31; no SIEM coverage of network elements
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07; SYS-08; SYS-09; BP-01 to BP-05
existing_controls: TACACS+ with MFA on core and edge routers; quarterly external scans; vendor advisory tracking; MDR on endpoints and cloud
treatment_plan: Authenticated scanning of all network elements; 14-day patch target for internet-facing critical advisories; SBC upgrades; network element logs to the SIEM; threat hunt on edge devices
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$10M (response, forensics, notification, rebuild of compromised elements; insurance limit $15M)

threat_event: Intruder moves from a compromised access element through the management plane and steals call detail records from the mediation archive (P08 runbook 1)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared local administrator accounts on access elements and SBCs; management VLAN reachable from POP corporate VLANs; over-privileged mediation service account; no CDR read logging
existing_controls: TACACS+ on core; jump hosts for most administration; cloud guardrails
treatment_plan: Named TACACS+ accounts with MFA on every element type; POP segmentation; read-only mediation service account; CDR read logging and egress alerts
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$6M (CPNI breach notice to up to 61,000 voice accounts; FCC exposure; counsel and forensics)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts corporate IT and the cloud production account, halting care, provisioning, dispatch, and billing (P08 runbook 2)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restores proven only for the OSS; IT contingency plan missing; privileged access management covers servers only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 access; SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-14; BP-09; BP-11 to BP-13
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MDR; isolated write-once backups in a second region; MFA everywhere
treatment_plan: IT contingency plan; quarterly restore tests for mediation, portal, and warehouse; ransomware tabletop 2026-11-19
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$5M (outage, SLA credits, response; about $2.6M of billing delayed)

threat_event: Destructive attack wipes or reconfigures access network elements, causing a service-area outage that includes 911 calling
threat_source: Nation-state actor or hacktivist with network access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared element credentials; configuration restore at scale untested; no out-of-band management at cabinets
existing_controls: Nightly configuration backups with a copy at CO-4; protected rings; NOC 24x7
treatment_plan: Named accounts with MFA; bulk configuration restore exercise for 40 cabinets; golden configurations for access elements

threat_event: Compromise of the lawful-intercept system exposes surveillance targets and court orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-10 reachable over the shared management network path; SSI appendix out of date
existing_controls: Restricted room with two-person entry; 4 authorized employees; TTP contract
treatment_plan: Isolated management path for SYS-10; compromise reporting procedure in P08; refile SSI policies
exposure_estimate_usd: Not quantified (national security harm; FCC and law enforcement exposure)

threat_event: Fraudster passes the chatbot "verify me" fallback with SSN4 and service address, views call detail, and changes the account to enable number port-out fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fallback accepted readily available biographical information (64.2010(c), (e)); disabled 2026-07-24 but not yet redesigned
existing_controls: Portal and app reset by one-time code; fallback disabled 2026-07-24
treatment_plan: Keep fallback disabled; account data only after portal sign-in; review of 2,300 fallback sessions; P10 conditions

threat_event: Pretexter obtains call detail by phone from an overflow call center agent without the account password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Overflow agents untrained on CPNI; call detail screens visible to the overflow role
treatment_plan: Remove call detail screens from the overflow role; CPNI training for vendor agents; monthly call sampling

threat_event: Shared administrator accounts on the legacy CLEC billing system are used to read or alter business customers' CPNI without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared accounts; no SIEM logging; no account-change notices; reset by account number and ZIP
existing_controls: Network access limited to POP-A; vendor support contract
treatment_plan: Named accounts; SIEM logging; change notices; accelerate migration to SYS-01 (2027-06-30)

threat_event: Attacker activity on network elements goes undetected for months because element logs and TACACS+ accounting are not monitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Network element syslog kept 90 days locally; TACACS+ accounting not reviewed; MDR scope excludes network elements
existing_controls: MDR on endpoints and cloud; NOC watches availability
treatment_plan: Forward element syslog and TACACS+ accounting to the SIEM; MDR use cases for network elements; 1-year retention

threat_event: Toll fraud through compromised hosted voice SIP credentials or customer PBX accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weak SIP credential rules on older tenant configurations; fraud alerting only on international destinations
existing_controls: International call blocking by default; daily fraud report
treatment_plan: Credential reset for older tenants; real-time fraud thresholds per tenant

threat_event: A CPNI breach is not reported to the USSS and FBI within 7 business days because staff follow the wrong (not yet effective) rule text
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 plan applied the 2023 amendments as if in effect; reporting facility access untested
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 matrix; set up and test reporting facility access; train regulatory affairs and the NOC

threat_event: FCC enforcement because the annual CPNI certification statement does not match actual practice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 statement described the chatbot authentication as compliant; evidence not gathered from the assessment
treatment_plan: Evidence-based statement for the CY2026 filing using P03 and P07; counsel review by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Hurricane damages outside plant and central office power, causing a multi-day outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coastal and rural plant; cabinet batteries about 8 hours
existing_controls: Generators with 72 hours of fuel; storm plan; DIRS reporting practiced
treatment_plan: Portable generators for cabinets serving 911-critical sites; fuel contracts; annual storm exercise

threat_event: A single fiber cut takes down both circuits of a "diverse" 911 circuit pair, isolating a PSAP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 14 legacy 911 circuit pairs share a fiber segment (2025 diversity audit)
treatment_plan: Re-route the 2 circuit pairs onto diverse paths; re-audit

threat_event: CO-6 generator fails during a utility outage and 911 facilities serving a PSAP lose power after the batteries drain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generator failed full-load test 2026-05-14; transfer switch on order
existing_controls: Batteries about 8 hours; portable generator at the warehouse
treatment_plan: Replace transfer switch; repeat full-load test; stage a portable generator at CO-6 until passed

threat_event: A PSAP is not notified within 30 minutes of an outage because contacts for POP-served areas are stale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PSAP contacts for POP-served areas last confirmed 2024
existing_controls: NOC PSAP list for ILEC areas confirmed 2026-01
treatment_plan: Confirm all PSAP contacts annually; one consolidated list

threat_event: An interconnected VoIP or hosted voice outage is not reported in NORS on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NOC procedures written for wireline thresholds; hosted voice monitored by Business Services
treatment_plan: Add VoIP thresholds to the NOC checklist; route hosted voice alarms to the NOC

threat_event: The company is removed from the Robocall Mitigation Database after missed traceback deadlines or a stale filing, so other providers stop accepting its calls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMD contact not updated within 10 business days; 2 of 18 tracebacks answered late
existing_controls: Robocall mitigation program; STIR/SHAKEN on IP network
treatment_plan: Update RMD filing; traceback on-call rota with 24-hour tracking

threat_event: Hosted voice customers originate illegal robocalls through the platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Know-your-customer checks for new hosted voice tenants are manual and inconsistent
treatment_plan: Documented know-your-customer checks; per-tenant call volume thresholds

threat_event: STIR/SHAKEN signing certificate expires or its private key is compromised, so calls go out unsigned or are labeled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Certificate renewal tracked manually
treatment_plan: Automated certificate expiry alerts; key in hardware security module

threat_event: Phished workforce account is used to export customer records from the BSS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 61 users hold the BSS bulk export right; export not alerted
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; phishing training
treatment_plan: Reduce export rights to 9 roles; SIEM alert on exports

threat_event: Care agent looks up and sells call detail or customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call detail views not reviewed
existing_controls: Background checks; sanctions policy covering CPNI
treatment_plan: Monthly review of call detail views against tickets (POAM-005)

threat_event: Former employee or contractor uses a shared network element password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 142 terminations in 12 months; shared passwords not rotated at departure
treatment_plan: Rotate shared passwords now; replace with named accounts (POAM-002)

threat_event: A vendor handling CPNI (chatbot, CCaaS, overflow center, bill print) suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 of 34 vendors with CPNI, PII, or network access unreviewed; contracts lack 24-hour notice
treatment_plan: Review the 22 vendors; contract amendments with CPNI, no-training, and 24-hour notice terms

threat_event: BSS vendor outage lasts longer than the customer care RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 12 h exceeds the BIA RTO 8 h
existing_controls: Hourly offline account report; vendor SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Negotiate 8-hour recovery terms at renewal; extend the offline report to show approval flags

threat_event: Cloud workloads other than the OSS cannot be restored within their RTOs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mediation, portal, and warehouse restores never tested
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests from 2026-11-12

threat_event: Network element configurations cannot be restored quickly at scale after a destructive event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bulk restore of more than a handful of devices never tested
existing_controls: Nightly backups with a CO-4 copy
treatment_plan: Bulk restore exercise for 40 cabinets; third copy in the backup account

threat_event: DDoS attack overwhelms DNS, broadband, or hosted voice addresses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing services
existing_controls: Always-on scrubbing from two upstream providers
treatment_plan: Keep the scrubbing contracts; annual mitigation test with both providers

threat_event: SS7 signaling abuse through the SS7 hub provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reliance on the hub provider's screening
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CTO; reassess when the TDM switches retire

threat_event: Unsupported TDM switches fail or are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor support ended 2024; retirement 2028
treatment_plan: Accelerate migration of 19,500 copper lines; compensating isolation

threat_event: SBCs reach end of support on 2026-12-31 without the planned upgrade
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Upgrade depends on a maintenance window in December
treatment_plan: Upgrade both SBCs by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Attacker uses default SNMP community strings on cabinet switches to map or change the network (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 25 sampled cabinet switches had default strings
existing_controls: Management VLAN not reachable from the internet
treatment_plan: Replace strings on all 268 cabinet switches; move to SNMPv3

threat_event: Intruder at a remote cabinet connects to a switch console port
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 4 visited cabinets had broken alarm contacts
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Network Engineering while alarm contacts are repaired in routine maintenance

threat_event: Lost or stolen field tablet exposes cached work orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 420 tablets in vehicles
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director (encryption and remote wipe in place)

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small group of administrators
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director (phishing-resistant MFA in place)

threat_event: Chatbot is manipulated by prompt injection into acting on the wrong account or disclosing data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Allow-list not yet enforced at the gateway for all actions
treatment_plan: Gateway allow-list; red-team test each release (P10)

threat_event: Churn prediction model uses CPNI to target offers without checking the customer's approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model reads CDR-derived features for all voice accounts; approval flag not checked
treatment_plan: Approval flag filter before scoring and campaign use; register entries (P10)

threat_event: The NOC alarm correlation tool suppresses or mis-ranks an alarm that affects 911, delaying PSAP notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tool auto-groups alarms; no validation against 911 circuit tags
existing_controls: NOC staff watch raw alarms for 911-tagged circuits
treatment_plan: Never suppress 911-tagged alarms; monthly validation (P10)

threat_event: Agent assist transcribes and stores calls at the vendor without adequate notice or contract protections
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recording notice does not mention AI transcription; contract allows vendor model improvement
treatment_plan: Update the notice; contract amendment; transcript retention 90 days (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste CPNI or network configurations into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved enterprise tool until the AI-005 pilot
treatment_plan: Enterprise assistant rollout; web filtering for public tools (P10)

threat_event: CALEA SSI policies for the merged entity are not on file and law enforcement cannot reach the senior officer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Amended policies not filed within 90 days of the 2025-07-01 merger; contact appendix stale
treatment_plan: Rewrite and file through CEFS

threat_event: Incomplete inventory of CLEC metro equipment leaves devices unpatched and unmonitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 POP devices missing from the OSS inventory
treatment_plan: Import POP devices into the OSS; discovery module

threat_event: Configuration drift on access elements leaves insecure services enabled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No baselines for access elements; Telnet and HTTP enabled on some
treatment_plan: Configuration standard STD-01 and monthly drift reports

threat_event: Enterprise and government customers move Business Services contracts to competitors that have SOC 2 reports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 report; informal change management on the hosted voice platform
existing_controls: Security questionnaires answered case by case
treatment_plan: SOC 2 Type 1 by 2027-03-31; Type 2 observation from 2027-04-01 (P09)

threat_event: Cooling or power failure in the CO-1 data hall takes down hosted voice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cooling plant for the data hall
existing_controls: Generator and UPS; standby node in the same hall
treatment_plan: Second cooling unit; standby hosted voice node at CO-4

threat_event: Legacy CLEC billing system fails before migration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hardware out of warranty
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Billing Director until migration on 2027-06-30

threat_event: Covered communications equipment enters the network through used or refurbished purchases
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No Covered List check in purchasing
treatment_plan: Covered List check in purchasing; annual attestation by the CTO

threat_event: Excess retention of CDRs and SSN digits enlarges breach impact
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 36 months of CDRs online; SSN4 kept for authentication
treatment_plan: Online CDR retention 18 months; stop collecting SSN4 for authentication

threat_event: Privileged server and SYS-18 sessions are not vaulted or recorded, so misuse cannot be traced
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PAM covers Windows servers and cloud only
treatment_plan: Extend PAM to jump hosts, network elements through TACACS+, and SYS-18

threat_event: A hosted voice platform change error causes a multi-tenant outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Informal change management for the hosted voice platform (P07: 7 of 25 changes unapproved)
existing_controls: Standby node; peer review by habit
treatment_plan: Change advisory board for Business Services; pre-change impact analysis

threat_event: OLT and SBC vendors' shared VPN account with standing access is used to reach the management network (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared vendor VPN account, no per-session approval, no recording, password unchanged since 2023
existing_controls: VPN requires MFA (shared token held by the vendor)
treatment_plan: Disable the shared account; named vendor accounts through the access broker with per-session approval and recording
